deployed_formula.rb_elite_youth_bonus_rule: Elite RB, integer age <=25, raw production >=0.65; 0.384*sqrt(years_of_upside), capped through deployed age function.
deployed_formula.rb_fractional_age_rule: When birth-date data exists, interpolate monotone integer-age anchors using fractional age.

existing_prospective_evidence.interpretation: Weeks 1-3 are collection-only/early descriptive evidence under frozen upstream studies and cannot authorize an RB model change.

legacy_production_lineage_diagnostic.interpretation: Legacy lineage is diagnostic only; a larger RB residual than the overall pool is a follow-up signal, not deployment authority.

next_step_if_green: Review A18 findings. If no material RB calibration concern is established, freeze no-change and continue to A19 WR Structural Integrity Audit V1. If a material concern remains, preregister a broad-cohort RB calibration study before fitting or validation.

benchmark_offense_forward.both_sources: 50% FantasyPros Trade-Desk-normalized points + 50% Sleeper league-scored points

scientific_limits: This audit can identify mechanical compression, discontinuities, age/youth-bonus sensitivity, coverage gaps, and lineage instability.
It cannot establish the true market price of RB scarcity.
It cannot infer that a specific named RB is too high or too low.
The no-youth-bonus counterfactual isolates the deployed mechanism; it is not a proposed production model.
Production V2 Phase 1 is transparent but uncalibrated.
Weeks 1-3 realized outcomes are too early under frozen prospective protocols to select or deploy an RB model change.
No new RB weight, age curve, production transform, youth premium, or player-specific adjustment is fit here.
